cases.observed: Demo seeding defaults Off. The empty-registration integration exercises registration, DNS/email verification, approval and observation without handbook/maps/recipes; DNS/email transports are synthetic. The existing local registration has historical operator provisioning and seeded content.
cases.recommendation: Repeat fresh empty onboarding through real owner DNS/email self-service before closing this case.

cases.feature: Action button acknowledgement and bottom status
cases.observed: Immediate busy/disabled state; duplicate activation executes once; bottom completion clears after three seconds, including when the originating button is removed.
cases.recommendation: Keep the generic feedback wrapper on new asynchronous actions.

cases.feature: HTML control coverage and cross-framework state compatibility
cases.observed: Native radio/select/multiple-select/checkbox/datalist plus real React 18 and Angular 20 application state and independently persisted synthetic record readback pass. Stale control review is rejected.
cases.recommendation: Support is bounded to the observed accessible controls; certify vendor widgets separately.

cases.feature: Natural-language mixed dropdown and checkbox intent
cases.observed: Real model chat understands Express plus Include gift wrap, presents Selected rather than internal true, supports Reject, and does not submit.
cases.recommendation: Retain mixed-intent and negation regression coverage.

cases.feature: Expand local fixture with tables and complex dynamic components
cases.observed: Added and tested async picklist loading/no-match/error/duplicate-label rejection and recovery, dependent contact, table row selection/editing, sorting/filtering/pagination, dynamic rows, modal scope, numeric constraints and persisted table/multiselect values.
cases.recommendation: This certifies the supported accessible fixture patterns. Vendor-specific virtualized grids or closed components still require their own adapter acceptance.

cases.feature: Pairing gives stale generic errors and confusing self-inclusive member count
cases.observed: Pairing is bilateral; counterpart count excludes this panel. Duplicate confirmation/revocation is idempotent and stale errors clear on successful action.
cases.recommendation: Use the counterpart list and current presence instead of interpreting total membership as live peers.

cases.feature: Disable pending action buttons and show progress state
cases.observed: Shared asynchronous-action feedback suppresses repeated activation and exposes working/completed status. Background presence does not resurrect an old notice.
cases.recommendation: Apply this shared path to newly introduced action controls.

cases.feature: Browser refresh loses visible pairing and continuation
cases.observed: Both actual browser tabs reload and rejoin their saved group using fresh endpoints. Ended private files and approvals are not restored.
cases.recommendation: Reauthorize only after consent expiry/revocation or loss of browser proof.

cases.feature: Inline Cancel or Reject in field review
cases.observed: Field review includes Reject; Save review includes Cancel save. Rejecting private-file review retains the ready file. Both cancellation journeys independently assert zero host submissions.
cases.recommendation: Keep fill approval and host Save approval separate.

cases.feature: Summary-only no-write request incorrectly produces field-fill review
cases.observed: Private summary-only prompt returns an answer with no field review or fill; synthetic host fields remain empty.
cases.recommendation: Continue enforcing read-only intent before generating write proposals.

cases.feature: Unified chat composer with paired-copilot at-mentions
cases.observed: Handoffs use @recipient in the normal bottom composer and Send. Missing sharing consent is rejected; setup is limited to files, pairing/linking and consent.
cases.recommendation: Use the shared composer for further delivery modes.

cases.feature: Ended live task and stale online UI produce unrecoverable generic handoff refusal
cases.observed: Reconnect, expiry/revocation and stale endpoint coverage pass; live offline workflow run 4062 reports COPILOT_RECIPIENT_OFFLINE without future delivery. Saved group remains.
cases.recommendation: An uncertain host effect is never automatically replayed; inspect before retrying.

cases.feature: Missing launcher on SDK bootstrap failure and absent loading/retry feedback
cases.observed: Injected SDK download failure leaves host usable and visible Retry recovers without host reload on local/public. Explicit retry bypasses the browser cached failed module import.
cases.recommendation: The eight-second attempt limit is a bound; injected recovery timings are not normal startup benchmarks.

cases.feature: Confirmer-controlled pairing lifetime separate from visitor-session inactivity
cases.observed: The confirmer chooses group name, hours/until-revoked and optional inactivity. Presence polling does not renew inactivity; persistence tests cover restart and expiry.
cases.recommendation: Until revoked persists consent, not private task data or perpetual live authorization.

cases.feature: Sender conversation trace for copilot handoffs
cases.observed: Sender chat shows the instruction, selected context, recipient and delivery result/time; receiver gets the authorized private context.
cases.recommendation: Private sender content clears when the task ends.

cases.feature: Workflow setup must explain owner capability and stale paired-session prerequisites
cases.observed: Workflow user authorization is distinct from website ownership. Independently linked single local target runs without peer pairing; another explicitly authorized same-owner target can join its saved group.
cases.recommendation: Owner must enable workflow capability; visitor must explicitly link; Action Policies still apply. Public temporary capability was restored Off.

cases.feature: Readable inspection results and downstream workflow use
cases.observed: Run 4060 shows per-website fields/forms/navigation without entered values. Run 4063 inspect -> summarize passes the task-bound result handle: current form has zero visible fields, yet real LLM correctly reports all three previously observed required fields.
cases.recommendation: Pass task-bound handles between steps before task cleanup; never store transaction text in durable generic workflow audit.

cases.observed: Runs 4059 and 4060 use the same saved group and website selection across both tab refreshes without new group/link IDs. Offline run 4062 fails clearly while retaining the group. No peer pairing dependency.
cases.recommendation: Saved groups are reusable target authorizations; commands resolve eligible live endpoints on each run.

cases.feature: Workflow instruction and copilot response in visitor chat history
cases.observed: Both visitor panels show full incoming workflow instruction/progress and readable inspection result. Task end removes private instruction/data and keeps a structural completion trace.
cases.recommendation: Review audit plus browser traces together; screenshot capture holds are excluded from latency measurements.
Retain this synthetic corpus as a release gate; additional languages/handwriting are unsupported.
cases.observed: Actual deployed parser/model: TXT, PDF, DOCX, PNG and JPEG, three correct fields and citations each. PDF/PNG Chrome uploads and summaries passed.

cases.feature: Reviewed fill and independent Save proof
cases.recommendation: Keep business-save readback host-specific. Observed fields alone never prove persistence.
cases.observed: PDF and PNG: fresh Customer field review, explicit fill, separate synthetic Save; exact returned record UUID and three values independently read back.

cases.recommendation: Expand custom-control coverage per host before advertising support.
cases.observed: Both browser runs navigated from Customer to Note then freshly inspected/filled. Unit cases reject invented values, missing/conflicting/repeated labels.

cases.recommendation: Keep supported formats explicit; add separate acceptance before adding languages/file types.
cases.observed: Capability separation, extension/MIME/signature/binary/size limits and instruction rejection pass. No private upload publishes shared sources.

cases.recommendation: Use fresh pairing codes and current preview authorization for future releases; pairing remains user consent rather than device attestation.
cases.observed: Anonymous live Chrome panels on loopback Customer and public flolah.cloud MCP Universe paired with bilateral confirmation; each panel displayed the other exact origin.

cases.recommendation: Pairing is explicit user consent, not proof of a single physical device.
cases.observed: Wrong owner, expiry/reuse, foreign instance/session, conflicting user links and unrelated group tests pass.

cases.feature: Private handoff to public destination form
cases.recommendation: Keep destination inspection and review; never interpret filled controls as a saved business record. Future website fixtures must supply their own observed controls.
cases.observed: Sharing without consent rejected; with consent, private integration passages reached the public panel. Real model proposed Inventory API and stdio from the file. Controls remained blank until approval, then both values were independently observed; no public submission.

cases.recommendation: Keep owner policy and entitled workflow-user binding separate.
cases.observed: Real signed-in editor saved direct targets, website selection and stable group; real runs 4058/4059/4060 completed without a peer pair.

cases.feature: Analytics privacy, ownership and consent isolation
cases.observed: Strict schema rejects raw paths/query strings, typed values, prompts and filenames; canaries absent report. Website HMAC IDs and owner-transfer isolation tested. Opt-out immediately stops events, and the next SDK request clears stale consent if opt-out transport was lost.

cases.observed: Controlled-clock pilot expired all 5,000 rows after 31 days. Tests cover removed/transferred websites, shorter retention, deduplication, site/global bounds and an analytics timeout that cannot block host actions.
cases.recommendation: Live-event retention is 30 days; existing operational checkpoints separately expire after seven days. Controlled clocks do not prove 30 elapsed wall-clock days.

cases.observed: Implemented and automatically tested website/owner-scoped daily coarse-network HMAC, canonical IPv4/IPv6 handling and browser/page-overlap hypotheses. Live network hints remain Off and trusted proxy list is empty; no real visitor network matches were collected.
cases.recommendation: Configure and verify the actual proxy peer, then run a consented synthetic multi-browser match/non-match test. Never treat shared IP or usage as identity or grant access.

cases.feature: Owner resend cooldown feedback and operations
cases.observed: Real sign-in succeeded after retries. Follow-up D includes OWNER_CODE_COOLDOWN with HTTP429/Retry-After and clear UI guidance; HTTP test confirms resending does not invalidate the valid code. Analytics/pairing operations have content-free named telemetry.
